reason: 2003 Paper 2 mark scheme (component 2 of the combined 9701 Nov 2003 file). Three question-paper leaves have no printed key of their own. 3(a)(iii) (why the standard enthalpy of formation of water equals the enthalpy of combustion of hydrogen): the scheme prints only 3(a)(i) (two marks) and 3(a)(ii) (one mark) on p7 and then goes straight to 3(b); there is no marking point for it (the question paper's 3(a) is [4], the scheme prints 3 marks), so it is recorded absent. 4(a)(ii) (equation for the ethene preparation): the scheme prints one 4(a)(i) block ('dehydration/elimination/cracking (1)' and the equation with its alternative (1) [2]) with no (ii) label, so both 4(a) leaves are shown the whole block. 4(c)(ii) (structure of PVC): the scheme prints one 4(c)(i) block holding both polymer structures ('tails required' (1) each, [2]) with no (ii) label, so both 4(c) leaves are shown the whole block. The scheme numbers the 4(d) steps (i) C6H10, (ii) Mr = 82, (iii) % carbon, while the question paper has only 4(d)(i) and (ii) (the percentage calculation is (ii)); the 'Mr = 82' and '% carbon' lines both fall in the question paper's 4(d)(ii) crop, so the printed '(iii)' label (p8 y195.6) that would otherwise show inside that crop is whited out by hand.
